paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.
model_annotation: This line chart illustrates how the minimum ADE₂₀ metric changes across different ratios of an in-context pool, comparing five methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the “Ratio,” ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2, marked numerically along the axis. The y-axis represents “minADE₂₀ (←),” scaled linearly from 15.5 to 17.5, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. The blue line, representing TrajICL, starts at approximately 16.7 and decreases monotonically to 15.5. The orange line, representing Head Tuning, begins at approximately 17.5 and declines slightly to around 17.2. The green line, representing FT, starts at 17.0, dips to 16.9, rises slightly to 16.95, then falls to 15.9 before rising again to 16.0. The red line, representing LoRA 16, begins at approximately 17.4 and decreases steadily to 16.9. The purple line, representing LoRA 64, starts at approximately 17.4 and declines gradually to 16.8.
